title: CHAPTER 18: MISCELLANEOUS GK, ONE-LINERS & CURRENT AFFAIRS

items: Odisha is the 8th largest state in India by area (1,55,707 sq. km).
The capital of Odisha is Bhubaneswar (new capital since 1948; formerly Cuttack).
Odisha was formed as a separate province on 1 April 1936 – the first linguistic province of India.
The official language Odia became a Classical Language in 2014 – the 6th classical language of India.
Chilika Lake is the largest coastal lagoon in Asia (and 2nd largest in the world).
Gahirmatha is the world's largest Olive Ridley sea turtle mass nesting site.
Bhitarkanika National Park has the highest density of saltwater crocodiles in India.
Simlipal is one of India's Project Tiger reserves and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
Hirakud Dam is the first major multipurpose river valley project in independent India.
Hirakud Dam is one of the longest earthen dams in the world (25.8 km).
Konark Sun Temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site (1984).
The Sun Temple at Konark is designed as a giant chariot of the Sun God with 24 wheels and 7 horses.
Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India; originated in temples of Odisha.
Baju Yatra at Cuttack celebrates ancient maritime trade of Kalinga civilisation.
Nandankanan Zoo in Bhubaneswar was the first zoo in the world to breed white tigers in captivity.
Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP) was India's first modern integrated steel plant (with German collaboration, 1955).
NALCO (Damanjodi-Angul) is one of the largest integrated aluminium producers in Asia.
Sukinda Valley in Jajpur has ~98% of India's total chromite reserves.
Odisha has the highest number of Scheduled Tribe (ST) population in India in absolute numbers.
Odisha is called the 'Rice Bowl of the East'.
Kandhamal Haldi (Turmeric) has a GI Tag from Odisha.
The Paika Rebellion (1817) is considered the First War of Independence by many historians.
Veer Surendra Sai fought against the British for over 30 years from Sambalpur.
Dhanu Yatra in Bargarh is the world's largest open-air theatre festival.
Pattachitra (Raghurajpur) is a GI Tagged traditional art form of Odisha.
Odisha Hockey teams are sponsored by the Odisha government; FIH World Cup hosted in 2018 and 2023.
APJ Abdul Kalam Island (Wheeler Island) in Balasore is India's premier missile test site.
Odisha has 30 districts and 3 revenue divisions.
The Deomali Peak (1,672 m) in Koraput is the highest point in Odisha.
